languageSettings.title: Language
languageSettings.launcherHint: The launcher's own texts. Applies at once; a text a translation lacks shows in English. Messages from Kiln itself stay in English for now.
languageSettings.gameHint: Kiln's own menus and messages in the game (kiln.json ui.language). A language Kiln has no texts for shows English. Mods choose their own.

toast.keptFiles: Files your mods wrote were kept
toast.keptFoldersDetail: {detail}. These mods may still run through Kiln or another loader. With the game closed, review or move the listed folders to stop them; your settings have not been deleted.

channel.worldWarning: A world you play with a test build may not load the same way on the release, and servers and players must run the same build to play together.

toBeta.title: Switch to the beta?
toBeta.what: Test builds of the next release, for testing with the Kiln Discord. The launcher installs the newest one and restarts. To test its Kiln in your game, install it on the Runtime page.
toBeta.back: You can switch back to the release here at any time.

back.title: Switch back to the release?
back.what: The launcher installs the newest release and restarts, also when it is older than this test build. {advice}

restore.label: Put back my profiles and settings from before the beta
restore.hint: Saved {when}, before the first start of a test build. Mods you added in the beta stay in the Library.

notice.switchBack: This game has Kiln {from} from a test build; Play puts this launcher's Kiln {to} in first.
notice.betaLauncher: This launcher is a test build; this game still has the release's Kiln. Install Kiln {version} on Runtime to test it.

advice.unknown: Releases before 0.2.0-dev.29 leave the test build's Kiln in your game: reinstall the release's Kiln on the Runtime page. Newer releases put their own Kiln in at the next Play.
advice.automatic: Kiln in your game goes back with it at the next Play.
advice.manual: This release leaves the test build's Kiln in your game. Reinstall the release's Kiln on the Runtime page.

notRunning.ember: Ember mods don't run yet: Ember has not published its mod ABI, so kiln-ember only finds and reports them. They stay in your list; running them will require a compatible loader update.

reason.incompleteList: the release list is too long to read to its end
reason.invalidMetadata: the newest release's kiln-release.json is not valid for this mod
reason.missingAsset: the newest release has no file with the expected name
reason.ambiguousAsset: the newest release has several files with the expected name
reason.ambiguousRelease: several releases share the highest version
reason.nonSemver: the versions are not semantic versions, so they cannot be ordered
reason.sameVersionUnbound: the same version is published, and Kiln does not know which upload of it you have
reason.network: no answer (offline, or not signed in where a sign-in is needed)
reason.sourceConflict: its update source changed and waits for your yes
reason.rateLimited: the provider's request limit is used up for now
reason.notFound: no repository or no matching release was found
reason.releaseRemoved: the release this copy came from is gone

detail.incompatible: Its release says it does not load on this Kiln.
detail.newUpload: Version {installed} was published again as another file.
detail.unsupported: Kiln does not know where this mod is published. Set a source to get update notices.
detail.disabled: Its provider is switched off in this build.
detail.unknown: Kiln cannot tell whether an update exists: {reason}.

oneActivation.busy: Kiln is still loading a profile in this game. Try again when that is done.

commands.selfUpdateDisabled: Self-update is disabled in this build

admin.notConnected: Not connected to the server's Kiln.Admin.
admin.needsNewer: This needs a newer Kiln.Admin on the server (it has no '{op}' op yet).

say.notYet: Not written yet: it appears after the next start.
